name: firstbell-page-gates
description: Browser gates for the evidence page. Drives the Chrome already on the machine, so nothing is downloaded.
comment: puppeteer-core is pinned exactly, not ranged. Every other dependency in this repository is pinned, and this was the one caret left. A gate whose own tooling can change under it between two runs cannot be the thing that decides whether a claim still holds: the run that passes and the run that fails would differ by a package nobody chose. 23.11.1 is the version every published gate report was measured on.
